newsitem.title: USA: EIS International says adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: EIS International says adopts rights plan.

text.p: EIS International Inc said on Monday that its directors had adopted a shareholder rights plan in which stock purchase rights will be distributed as a dividend at the rate of one right for each share of EIS common stock.

Each right will entitle the holders of common stock of EIS to purchase one one-thousandth of a share of a new series of junior participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $20.00, EIS said in a statement.
The plan applies to stock outstanding as of the close of business on May 27, EIS said.

"The plan is designed to deter coercive or unfair takeover tactics and to prevent an acquirer from gaining control of the company without offering a fair price to all of the company's shareholders," EIS said.
The rights will expire on May 16, 2007, unless earlier redeemed or exchanged, the company added.
EIS provides call management software, systems and services to the call center industry.
